corrections.fieldOrRectangle: AcroForm text field "Defendants ssn", rect [x0,y0,x1,y1] as published by the blank source, labelled "Defendant's SSN:" on the page
corrections.observedResult: The participant's full legal name ("Jordan Avery Reyes") is drawn into the Defendant's SSN slot. The page reads: Defendant's Birthdate: 1991-04-17  Defendant's SSN: Jordan Avery Reyes. The same map file both lists "Defendants ssn" in manualFields (protected, left for manual completion) and binds it in bindings to participant.full_legal_name; field-classification.json classifies it manual. A field the map records as protected was written, and it was written with a value of the wrong kind.
corrections.requiredResult: "Defendants ssn" is a manual-class field and must remain blank in the finalized artifact. It must never receive participant.full_legal_name; an SSN slot carrying a name is substantively wrong on a filed Kentucky order.
corrections.smallestCorrection: Remove the {"field":"Defendants ssn","class":"manual","factId":"participant.full_legal_name"} entry from production-field-map.json bindings so the field falls through to the manual/protected path, then re-render the fixtures and refresh the sidecar. No other binding on this family changes.

corrections.fieldOrRectangle: AcroForm choice field "3 County Dropdown" (/Ch, 121 options), rect [452.0, 692.8, 576.0, 706.2]
corrections.observedResult: A single 791-glyph text run is drawn at y1=692.2, x=[452.0..507.6] — starting exactly at the field rect left edge but BELOW the rect's lower bound, so it is clipped by the County rule line and is visually an illegible smear. The run is the field's entire /Opt list (all 120 Kentucky county names plus the blank option) concatenated: 121 options total 792 characters against 791 glyphs drawn. The field's actual value /V is " " (nothing selected). Text extraction returns AAABBBBBBBBBBBBBCCCCCCCCCCCCCDEEEF... because the subset font carries no usable ToUnicode.
corrections.requiredResult: A /Ch field must flatten to its selected value only, drawn once, legibly, inside the widget rect. With /V = " " (no county selected) the County region must be left blank, exactly as the blank source renders it.
corrections.smallestCorrection: In the flat-render path for /Ch fields, draw the selected value (/V) rather than the /Opt option list, and skip the draw entirely when /V is empty or whitespace. Re-render this family's fixtures and contact sheet and refresh the sidecar. The Case Number binding on this family is correct and unaffected.
